source_snapshot.scope: current newest-supported 42.0 source, release, package, named tests/mocks, direct UT_CORE call, and directly invoked PZCodebase symbols
source_snapshot.observed_build_evidence: B42.16 API comments in the current test mocks; no game process or live runtime was inspected

registration.proof: registries.lua line 286 registers the exact namespaced ID and the runtime constant is byte-identical.
registration.positive_path: CharacterTrait.register receives UniversalTraits:UT_acrophobic and the loaded module gates on that exact string.
registration.negative_path: UT_acrophobic without the UniversalTraits namespace is a different ResourceLocation input and is not this registration.

definition_parser.proof: The complete current block is lines 2044-2052 with identity/UI fields, Cost=-4, and DisabledInMultiplayer=true.
definition_parser.positive_path: A deterministic block read reaches the matching closing brace and yields every declared field/value.
definition_parser.negative_path: Removing the closing brace or CharacterTrait identity would make that exact block structurally incomplete.
missing_proof: No in-game ScriptManager parse/load or matching log was permitted or observed.

namespace.proof: Registration, CharacterTrait, runtime constant, and both English UI keys consistently use the acrophobic stem and full runtime namespace.
namespace.positive_path: The definition and runtime resolve UniversalTraits:UT_acrophobic while UIName and UIDescription resolve UI_UT_acrophobic and UI_UT_acrophobicDesc.
namespace.negative_path: Substituting UT_acrophobia or an unnamespaced runtime ID matches none of the inspected owned anchors.

cost_xp_grants_exclusions.proof: The exact definition has Cost=-4 and declares no XPBoosts, GrantedTraits, or MutuallyExclusiveTraits.
cost_xp_grants_exclusions.positive_path: Reading only the complete block yields cost -4 and empty relationship fields.
cost_xp_grants_exclusions.negative_path: Any claimed XP boost, granted trait, or exclusion has no field in this definition and therefore fails exact membership.

source_intent.proof: The source comment, display name, and runtime agree on fear/panic while above ground, but no historical upstream source was supplied and the description's height-scaling promise conflicts with the binary runtime predicate.
source_intent.positive_path: At any Z greater than zero the implementation raises PANIC, matching the basic fear-of-heights intent.
source_intent.negative_path: Z=1 and Z=10 produce the same +5, rejecting an interpretation that impact becomes harder with greater height.
missing_proof: No upstream source-mod commit/tag was supplied for historical intent equivalence.

runtime_path.proof: EveryOneMinute -> getPlayer -> UTCore.hasTrait -> getZ>0 -> getStats -> PANIC get -> +5 -> clamp -> PANIC set.
runtime_path.positive_path: A carrier at Z=1 and PANIC=20 reaches set(PANIC,25).
runtime_path.negative_path: Nil player, absent trait, or Z<=0 prevents the Stats write.

numbers.proof: Static transformation is PANIC'=min(100,PANIC+5) for each elevated dispatch; CharacterStat.PANIC is defined with range 0..100 and Stats.set clamps again.
numbers.negative_path: PANIC=98 at Z=1 computes 100, while the same value at Z=0 is untouched.
missing_proof: No in-game numeric observation confirmed the Lua-to-Java value path.

cadence.proof: The module subscribes only to Events.EveryOneMinute; GameTime triggers that event when the minute stamp changes.
cadence.positive_path: One producer fire invokes the subscribed callback once under a single module evaluation.
cadence.negative_path: EveryTenMinutes has no subscription in this module and cannot directly invoke this handler.

cooldown.proof: No trait-owned timestamp or counter exists; event cadence and Z/trait predicates are the only gates.
cooldown.positive_path: Two elevated minute events can apply two +5 updates until capped.
cooldown.negative_path: Elapsed ticks without EveryOneMinute produce no callback and no update.

reset_save_load.proof: The module owns no serialized state; each callback re-reads engine-owned player identity, Z, and PANIC, and production UTCore invalidates trait-result cache when player identity changes.
reset_save_load.positive_path: After a current-version reload with a new player receiver at Z>0, the next event should read the loaded PANIC and add 5.
reset_save_load.negative_path: A reloaded player at Z=0 should not inherit an elevated predicate from the prior receiver.
missing_proof: No current-version save/reload session verified callback availability, player-identity cache invalidation, and loaded PANIC behavior together.

java_lua.proof: Static receivers exist: IsoPlayer inherits getZ, IsoGameCharacter exposes getStats, Stats exposes get/set(CharacterStat,float), and PANIC is registered.
java_lua.positive_path: A real player receiver supplies float Z and Stats accepts CharacterStat.PANIC for get/set.
java_lua.negative_path: Nil player exits before Java calls; an absent CharacterStat binding would fail at the enum-keyed access.
missing_proof: No live Kahlua Java-bridge invocation was observed.

kahlua.proof: The module uses ordinary local functions, early returns, colon calls, numeric operations, math.min, and global event/enum tables with no unsupported syntax identified.
kahlua.positive_path: Kahlua with getPlayer, UTCore, CharacterStat, math, and Events bindings can evaluate and register the callback.
kahlua.negative_path: Removing CharacterStat.PANIC or Events.EveryOneMinute makes the dependency boundary fail despite valid Lua syntax.
missing_proof: No in-game Kahlua module evaluation was observed; standard-Lua syntax was not run in this assignment.

events.proof: LuaEventManager registers EveryOneMinute, GameTime triggers it on minute-stamp change, and the module adds one handler per module evaluation.
events.positive_path: One normal cached module load followed by one minute-stamp transition should invoke one handler.
events.negative_path: Evaluating the file twice without module-cache discipline adds duplicate handlers because the module has no Remove or registration guard.
missing_proof: No full exit/relaunch confirmed actual loader caching and single registration in game.

stacking_interactions.proof: This trait performs an ordered read-modify-write on PANIC and clamps to 100; it declares no exclusions and owns no interaction registry.
stacking_interactions.positive_path: If another system writes PANIC before this callback, this callback reads that current value and adds 5 up to 100.
stacking_interactions.negative_path: At Z=0 this trait contributes no write; at PANIC=100 its marginal contribution is zero.
missing_proof: No in-game interaction run established listener ordering or emergent interaction behavior; other traits were intentionally not inspected.

multiplayer.proof: UTMods is single-player-only; DisabledInMultiplayer=true is evidence only of the selection exclusion guard.
multiplayer.negative_path: Absence of synchronization/client-server branches does not create missing acceptance proof because multiplayer is excluded from scope.

display.proof: UI_UT_acrophobic resolves to Acrophobic and the definition uses that exact key.
display.positive_path: Resolve UIName through the English JSON object and obtain Acrophobic.
display.negative_path: Resolving UI_UT_acrophobicDesc yields description copy, not the display label.

description.proof: The description says 'The higher up you are, the harder it is to function,' but runtime uses only the binary predicate Z>0 and applies the same +5 at every positive Z.
description.positive_path: At Z=1 the callback raises PANIC by 5, supporting the basic heights trigger.
description.negative_path: Z=2 and Z=10 do not increase magnitude beyond Z=1, contradicting the stated comparative scaling.

localization.proof: Both exact English keys exist and parse; no permitted evidence establishes owned non-English translations.
localization.positive_path: English name and description resolve from UI.json.
localization.negative_path: A non-English owned translation cannot be proven from the inspected English-only surface.
missing_proof: No non-English localization file for this trait was present in the selected ledger evidence or permitted exact reads.

balance.proof: Static maximum gain is +5 per elevated minute event, reaching 100 from zero after 20 events; definition cost is -4.
balance.positive_path: Twenty uninterrupted elevated dispatches from zero compute the cap of 100.
balance.negative_path: Ground-level dispatches add zero and post-cap dispatches have zero marginal effect.
missing_proof: No gameplay telemetry, recovery-context measurement, or comparative playtest was available.

performance.proof: Static work is O(1) per minute event with early nil/trait/Z exits and no trait-owned growth.
performance.positive_path: An elevated carrier executes one player lookup, one trait gate, one Z read, and one Stats read/write chain.
performance.negative_path: Nil player or absent trait avoids all later calls; ground level avoids Stats access.
missing_proof: No in-game profiler capture measured callback or UTCore cache cost.

tests.proof: Current named tests at lines 3437-3448 cover elevated positive and Z=0 negative paths but assert only PANIC>0 for the positive case.
tests.positive_path: Removing the elevated write or adding a ground-level write fails the named assertions.
tests.negative_path: Changing +5 to +1 or removing the cap still passes these two tests; nil-player, absent-trait, and current-version save/reload paths are absent.
missing_proof: No exact +5 assertion, cap assertion, nil-player case, absent-trait case, higher-Z equivalence case, production UTCore path, or save/reload test exists in the named slice.
Tests were not run because commands/tests were explicitly forbidden.

mocks.proof: MockPlayer supplies Z and Stats get/set, and EveryOneMinute.fire calls zero-argument handlers, but mock UTCore.hasTrait performs string membership instead of production instanceof -> ResourceLocation -> CharacterTrait -> player:hasTrait -> cache behavior.
mocks.positive_path: The named tests exercise Z, PANIC get/set, active-player replacement, and zero-argument event dispatch.
mocks.negative_path: A defect in production ResourceLocation resolution, CharacterTrait lookup, receiver type checking, or trait-result cache behavior can pass the simplified mock.
missing_proof: No negative fixture proves the named tests fail when the production UTCore trait-resolution contract is broken.

source_release_parity.proof: SHA-256 matches for source/release runtime, registries, definitions, and English UI files.
source_release_parity.positive_path: Each authorized source file has the same hash as its 42.0 release counterpart.
source_release_parity.negative_path: Any one-byte release divergence changes SHA-256 and fails parity.

packaging.proof: The 42.0 release contains the matching trait runtime and shared registration/definition/UI anchors; root and both release mod.info files match and declare id=UniversalTraits, require=UT_CORE, versionMin=42.0, and single-player-only description.
packaging.positive_path: Loading the 42.0 package has the trait module plus its required shared metadata and UT_CORE dependency declaration.
packaging.negative_path: Removing the release trait module leaves registration/definition/UI without this runtime effect and fails the existence/hash proof.

findings.summary: English copy promises increasing impairment with greater height, but runtime magnitude is constant for every Z>0.
Named tests do not prove exact +5, cap 100, nil player, absent trait, higher-Z equivalence, or current-version save/reload.
The string-membership UTCore.hasTrait mock bypasses production receiver checking, ResourceLocation/CharacterTrait lookup, and caching.
The retained wave row cited run_tests.lua:3317-3328, which now belongs to unrelated tests; current acrophobic tests are at 3437-3448.

validation.method: read-only exact-scope reconciliation; no commands/tests/game/deploy/Git/GUI/process/task operations beyond bounded file inspection and artifact validation
non_goals: multiplayer behavior, synchronization, migration, tests, and documentation
validation.required_runtime_gap: Current-version save/reload remains runtime-unproven and requires an in-game session outside this assignment.
